Dear Madam
I am much obliged for your offer but I am afraid you have been forestalled as we have had two papers upon Palermo and Taormina by Miss [Florence Freeman](/person/524), written and we could hardly go over the same ground[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^2]: Florence Freeman, \'Taormina and its Neighbourhood\' MP 3s 2 (December 1891), 617-29; and \'Palermo and its Neighbourhood\' MP 3s 6 (September 1893), 296-310.
